references.text: Describes the slaughter of the burnt offering and how Aaron's sons are to bring the blood and sprinkle it around on the altar
Instruction to slaughter the burnt offering on the north side of the altar and sprinkle the blood around on the altar
Moses slaughtered the ram and sprinkled the blood around on the altar during the consecration of Aaron and his sons
Describes the sprinkling of blood around on the altar with the peace offering
The blood from the guilt offering is to be sprinkled around on the altar
Instruction to slaughter the ram and sprinkle the blood around on the altar at the priestly consecration
Moses sprinkled blood on the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship, and almost everything is cleansed with blood according to the law
